Cloud mutations cross three boundaries: pooled REST and bare ``urlopen`` make one attempt. The ACLI subprocess performs bounded ``Retry-After`` retries. Reporter and comment apply phases explicitly remain single-attempt. ADR 0103 S3 retired the handler-level retry wrapper, so no dispatch-level retry sits above the transport. The tables below assign every mutation its transport seam, dispatch level, attempt policy, and duplicate-write disposition, while ``_NON_MUTATING`` accounts for every read, helper, and constructor so new members cannot inherit a policy silently. Deliberately retried operations are idempotent or deduplicated. Creates use the ``rebar-id`` lookup, edits target stable fields or ids, label operations are set-like, and deletes tolerate absence. Relationship creation can duplicate transiently but the differ reconverges. Comment creation has no idempotency key and therefore stays single-attempt.
